text: All good, but it is way too expensive, especially in INR. I believe the company should give a regional pricing option, as this is straightaway converted from USD to INR type of pricing.I genuinely want to rate it Good, but considering the pricing, it is not at all affordable on a long-term basis. The free option is not a good choice here either, as the word limit is very restrictive. I think the pricing should have been like how Whisperflow has done for India, or regional pricing.
